//Build 32 bit overlay library, necessary for the overlay to work
// with 32 bit processes.
overlay-xcompile:BOOL=OFF

//Build package.
packaging:BOOL=OFF

pkgcfg_lib_MySQL_mariadb:FILEPATH=/usr/lib64/libmariadb.so

plugins:BOOL=ON

//Build support for custom Diffie-Hellman parameters.
qssldiffiehellmanparameters:BOOL=ON

//Build Linux screen sharing (XDG desktop portal + PipeWire).
screen-share-pipewire:BOOL=ON

//Build the server (Murmur)
server:BOOL=ON

//Build static binaries.
static:BOOL=OFF

//Build binaries in a way that allows easier debugging.
symbols:BOOL=OFF

//Build tests.
tests:BOOL=OFF

//Enable the tracy profiler.
tracy:BOOL=OFF

//No help, variable specified on the command line.
translations:UNINITIALIZED=OFF

//Try to query install paths from pkgconf - this is incompatible
// to using CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX

//Allow using compile-time timestamps

//All warnings are treated as errors.
